assumptions: rotation-invariant temperature-independent collision law at fixed internal state and mass convention
separate Maxwellians with isotropic temperatures; relative mean drift U
finite required radial moments and justified Taylor expansion
same sigma_1(g) underlies Q11 and Q12; provenance string is a hypothesis, not an admission

ownership.drift_dissipation: already included once across Q_a,Q_b; never add K|U|^2 again
ownership.heat_capacity: species translational C_V=(3/2)*n*k_B; separate from thermal particle count
ownership.neutral_mass: Ar*m_u already includes bound-electron/nuclear rest-mass convention; no additional binding correction
ownership.absent_population: temperature RHS is null; no invented temperature

scope_limits.drift_cutoff: caller-supplied 0<eta_max<1; an operational domain restriction, not a certified remainder bound
scope_limits.unequal_T_quadratic_parts: signed; do not clamp each species to positive
scope_limits.explicit_T_dependent_law: requires extra derivative term; no automatic Coulomb/screening extension
